note: Magic events read by hand from shops' calendar pictures on X (docs/README.md, "X posts"). One entry per event: d (YYYY-MM-DD), t (HH:MM, or ""), p (prefecture, JIS 1-47), c (city), store (spelled as on Tonamel when the shop lists there too), name, f (formats), url (the post on X), read (the day it was read).
